headline: Voted to send Mayor a letter backing City ownership of 61 acres at Trask Lane and approved March 4 minutes.
summary: The committee heard public concerns about wetlands and Beverly Commons, got updates from several boards and commissions, and reviewed open space issues by ward, including the Trask Lane parcel, Endicott College trails, Norwood Pond Bridge, and Beverly Commons footbridge. It also discussed 2026 goals from the annual Open Space Plan and approved its March 4, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved a motion to draft a letter to the Mayor advocating for the City's ownership of the 61 acres of land at Trask Lane, with Greenbelt holding a Conservation Restriction; motion carried 8-0.
Approved the March 4, 2026 meeting minutes as presented; motion carried 7-0.
